name: NVIDIA
analysis_summary: Trend remains intact above the 50DMA, but RSI is extended. Existing holders sit tight; new entries wait for a controlled pullback toward the 118 area before scaling in.
risk_alerts: RSI is extended; crowded long positioning amplifies any pullback.
Valuation is sensitive to any growth re-rating from hyperscaler capex commentary.
positive_catalysts: Hyperscaler AI capex guidance remains strong into the next cycle.
Data-center GPU demand visibility extends through next-gen platform ramp.

name: Microsoft
analysis_summary: Azure and Copilot monetization underpin a constructive medium-term setup; price is consolidating near support, wait for clearer risk/reward.
risk_alerts: Near-term upside hinges on next earnings guidance and megacap breadth.
Capex acceleration may pressure operating margins short-term.
positive_catalysts: Azure AI consumption cohorts are expanding quarter over quarter.
Copilot attach across M365 enterprise seats remains a structural lever.

name: Apple
analysis_summary: Price has stabilized above the 20DMA and reclaimed the 50DMA, suggesting an improving setup; staged entries preferred over chasing strength.
risk_alerts: China demand and FX exposure remain key watch items.
Services growth normalization could cap multiple expansion.
positive_catalysts: Apple Intelligence rollout supports a multi-year device upgrade cycle.
Services gross margin remains structurally accretive.

name: Tesla
